what: The item list section sticks to the top of the screen (below the header height) and scrolls for (item count − 1) × half the screen height, and as the current item’s content folds, the next item’s content unfolds (height divided linearly over scroll). The current item gets is-on, and the paired photo panel ([data-fx-part=media] data-index) changes, easing back from 1.2 to 1 over 2.5s power2.out

options.top: Sticky position — px from the top of the screen, default 42 (header height)
options.step: Scroll used per item (multiple of screen height), default .5
options.settle: Duration for the new photo to fade back (s), default 2.5
options.wide: Fixed only at this width or above (px), default 1024 — below that, everything is an expanded list
options.[data-fx-part=content]: Content that folds and unfolds inside the item (required)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo plates to swap (optional, one per item, paired by data-index) — the current one gets is-on

from.where: service.html .tw-sa (seven service items — original [data-scroll-accordion]: start: top top+=42px」, end +=(n−1)×innerHeight×.5, pin·pinSpacing·scrub 0, photo Fo 1.2→1 2.5s power2.out)

note: The original also shrinks section height by the folded amount to fit the pin-spacer — this part only splits the content height. On narrow screens everything is expanded without pinning
